title: Greymatter hosted API quick eval — scheduling
text:
Greymatter hosted API quick eval — scheduling

['From: Alex Rivera <alex@greymatter.ai>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo request — evaluating hosted API

Hi Redwood team,

I signed up via the onramp form this morning — we’re Greymatter (small ML infra startup) and we’re kicking off a quick evaluation of hosted inference for a retrieval+LLM path. Looking for a focused 20–30 minute walkthrough of the Hosted API, sandbox access, and a few performance questions (latency at 256 tokens, embeddings throughput).

High level:
- Use case: user-facing retrieval + summarization (low latency important)
- Expected qps: start at 5–10, expect to grow

Availability next week: Mon/Tue all morning PT, Wed afternoon PT.

Can someone from the PLG team schedule a short session and give sandbox creds for a quick smoke test?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
CTO, Greymatter
alex@greymatter.ai
(415) 555-0198

---
Note: This message was sent from the self-serve onramp and also forwarded to PLG inbox for scheduling.', 'From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera <alex@greymatter.ai>
Cc: diego.fernandez@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — evaluating hosted API

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually) and welcome — excited to help.

We can definitely do a short 20–30 minute hosted API walkthrough and spin up a sandbox for you to smoke test. Diego (cc) is our SDR who will coordinate the calendar and provisioning; Kimberly (cc) can help with any perf-specific details if needed.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Apr 2, 10:00–10:30
- Tue Apr 2, 11:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 3, 14:00–14:30

If none of those work feel free to pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/onramp-30 — I’ll reserve a short slot and we’ll include a short agenda: 1) quick intro 2) live quickwalk using your sample queries 3) next steps (billing / Dedicated sizing)

Diego — once Alex confirms we’ll provision the sandbox and attach creds.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Senior Growth, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

[Redwood Inference]', 'From: Alex Rivera <alex@greymatter.ai>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2028 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — evaluating hosted API

Thanks Sean — Tue Apr 2 at 11:00 PT works best for us (me and our ML lead).

A couple quick asks so we can prepare:
- Can you provision a sandbox API key with 1M token credit and a small sample dataset attached?
- We’ll send a short sample prompt set before the call.
- If possible, can Kimberly hop on for the perf discussion (256 token latency expectations + batching guidance)?

If you need anything from our side (IP allowlist, contact for SSO), reply and I’ll loop them in.

Appreciate it —
Alex

', 'From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick demo request — evaluating hosted API

Sean / Kimberly — I’ve claimed this intake and will run the 11:00 PT slot on Tue. I’ll also provision a temp sandbox key (1M token credit) and attach the credential file to the confirmation message.

Questions for you both:
- Do we want to include the quick perf doc (greymatter-brief.pdf) in the confirmation? It summarizes their use case and sample load.
- Kimberly — can you prepare 1 slide on latency/quantization tradeoffs at 256 tokens we can share live?

I’ll create the Google Calendar invite and set the meeting to 30 minutes.

— Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

Alex — confirmed for Tue Apr 2, 11:00–11:30 PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=greymatter-demo

Attachments: sandbox-credentials.txt (temporary API key, expires in 7 days), greymatter-brief.pdf (we included a short perf cheat-sheet).

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m: intros + goals
- 5–15m: live quickwalk (your sample prompts, hosted API + embeddings)
- 15–25m: perf/ops Q&A (latency targets, batching, KV cache) — Kimberly to lead
- 25–30m: next steps (trial sizing, Dedicated options)

Prework: please upload 3–5 representative prompts to the shared doc or paste into the calendar event — we’ll use those during the quickwalk.

If you need IP allowlist entries, provide the CIDR or source IP and Diego will add it.

Looking forward —
Sean Gallagher
Senior Growth, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
